snippet.title: Line Slider: Paint the World Trailer
snippet.description:
MassDiGI SIP18 trailer for Line Slider: Paint the World game. 

Bip is a cute, mischievous little devil who wants to cover the town in paint, but the townspeople aren’t happy about it! Help Bip escape by painting your own paths for him to travel on. Dodge obstacles and collect as many paint drops as you can! Coming soon!

2018
